name: Magyarnádalja (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and light grey at the fly, charged at the centre of the blue with the municipal arms of Magyarnádalja: a crowned blue shield with a yellow reed and a ploughshare.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
